headline: Finance Committee to consider funding changes for municipal maintenance, JFK Coliseum Chiller Plant, Wolfe Park Recreation Complex, and related budget items.
summary: The committee will review a set of resolutions amending the Community Improvement Program for various projects, including building demolition, deferred maintenance, hazmat equipment, dental and oral health programs, and park improvements. It will also consider budget authorizations tied to these and other city projects.
